basics.name: Alan Karp
basics.label: Director, Business Operations and AI Enablement
basics.summary: AI Program Manager with 10 years driving enterprise transformation at PE-backed manufacturing platforms. At DwyerOmega, led cross-functional program execution across ERP/MRP, AMS, CRM/MarTech, and enterprise BI through 6 acquisitions ($800M+), reporting to PE stakeholders and executive leadership throughout. Currently founder of Syrup Labs AI, building xxOS (an agentic operating system and multi-machine agent fleet) plus lead capture workflows and automation infrastructure for small businesses, translating messy operational realities into structured, repeatable automation programs. Chemical engineer by training with manufacturing and wire engineering work behind it: at DwyerOmega, built SpaceX's wires, including 50K+ UL wires. Manufacturing specialist: ERP/MRP integration, M&A consolidation, and AI-assisted knowledge management across industrial operations. MBA, Villanova (Strategy, Analytics, AI/ML). B.S. Chemical Engineering, UMBC.

work.name: Syrup Labs AI (syrp.ai)
work.summary: Title of record: AI Automation Consultant. AI automation consultancy building and deploying bootstrapped agentic systems, lead capture workflows, and customer support automation for small and local businesses. Built AI automation systems for retail, hospitality, and local services use cases.
highlights: Founded Syrup Labs AI and built xxOS, an agentic operating system. Its Mission Control dashboard (Next.js, SQLite) has 39 panels for agent fleets, tasks, costs, and workflows, with 554 merged pull requests.

Run a multi-machine agent fleet (Hermes, OpenClaw, OmniRoute, Claude Code) across 4 machines over Tailscale, with Telegram bots, Obsidian knowledge vaults, and Understand-Anything code graphs that agents read for context.

Led end-to-end program delivery for AI automation builds, from scoping through deployment: scoped, priced, built, tested, and rolled out agentic systems with ROI tied to admin time saved and lead capture volume.
Built and internally validated AI concierge, intake, and lead-routing systems on Syrup Labs' own infrastructure.

Built parent/subagent architectures grounded in business-specific knowledge bases, with prompt guardrails, FAQ handling, escalation logic, and intent separation between support and qualified lead triggers.
Implemented low-code automation pipelines using GoHighLevel, HubSpot, n8n, Google Sheets, and Gmail.
Defined shared schemas for agent secrets, notes, artifacts, registry rows, and pull request attribution so every tool and agent reads the same fields.
Building a job application product where every claim in a draft must cite a source file and unbacked claims are refused.
Translated ambiguous business goals into structured automation roadmaps; managed full engagement lifecycle from discovery through phased rollout and stakeholder onboarding.

work.name: DwyerOmega
work.summary: Title of record: AI & Enterprise Transformation Manager. PE-backed industrial sensors, instrumentation, and semiconductor manufacturer; enterprise transformation spanning ERP/MRP, AMS, CRM/MarTech, and enterprise BI across Operations, Finance, Commercial, IT, Supply Chain, and PE stakeholders.
highlights: Led AI and enterprise transformation programs across 6 acquisitions ($800M+), integrating ERP/MRP (SAP S/4HANA, SyteLine, QAD), AMS, CRM/MarTech, and enterprise BI while reporting directly to PE stakeholders and C-suite leadership.

Applied AI and large language models across operational workflows including documentation generation, requirements analysis, data reconciliation automation, and vendor performance reporting, delivered at scale across post-merger integration environments.

Managed program and project execution across cross-functional teams spanning Operations, Finance, Commercial, IT, and Supply Chain; standardized KPIs and integration playbooks for repeatable M&A execution.

Owned enterprise reporting governance and reconciliation across global orders, sales, pricing, quality, and inventory; supported executive and PE decisions tied to pricing, margin, and working capital.
Oversaw 15-20 resource offshore vendor team: day-to-day tasking, prioritization, progress reporting, and delivery performance tracking.
Served as Global Admin for Jira and Confluence; deployed AI-assisted knowledge management in Confluence to improve documentation quality and governance scalability.
Led greenfield implementation planning for enterprise AMS and Microsoft Fabric; coordinated cross-functional discovery, harmonization, and planning with external consulting partner.
Built repeatable data-forensics workflow using Power Query, DAX Studio, and KNIME to reconcile large datasets and validate executive reporting when data integrity was disputed.

work.name: DwyerOmega
work.summary: Automation, analytics, and continuous improvement in PE-backed sensor and wire manufacturing; 3 consecutive Top Performer of the Year awards.
highlights: Built SpaceX's wires, including 50K+ UL wires.

Designed and executed $2M+ in automation and robotics-driven capital projects, improving throughput, reducing labor and overhead costs, and supporting sensor performance; served as cross-functional lead coordinating engineering, operations, and supply chain.

Applied analytics and predictive methods to planning and inventory; reduced on-hand inventory by more than 60% across a $20M+ inventory base while maintaining internal service levels and improving delivery performance.
Led Lean and continuous improvement initiatives including standardized work design, root-cause problem solving, and Kaizen events; drove sustained improvements in scrap, uptime, and changeover.
Built KPI dashboards with operations, engineering, and supply chain leadership to improve executive visibility into output, scrap, and operational constraints.

highlights: Managed 40+ employees across 14+ production lines in a 24/7 environment, driving safety, quality, and delivery performance.
Contributed to $3M+ in annualized labor savings through workflow redesign, line balancing, and reduced overtime.

highlights: Spearheaded startup of a $20M sister facility near Atlanta, GA, including full plant design, equipment procurement, process development, and production line commissioning from greenfield.
Served as day-to-day technical lead for a 30+ FTE production team across safety, quality, process, and customer issues.

highlights: Optimized final stages of the foam expansion process, increasing line speeds by an average of 60 meters per hour and generating $1M+ in annualized revenue impact.
